cohort_total_n_excerpt: A total of 1,162 prostate cancer cases and 3,124 age-matched hospital controls from several U.S. hospitals were studied to identify associations between prostate cancer and life-style variables.
reason: The abstract evaluates prostate cancer generally in a hospital-based case-control study. It does not analyze high-grade, advanced, metastatic, lethal, or another explicitly aggressive incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Cigarette smoking and alcohol consumption were not related to the risk of prostate cancer.
estimate_classifications.reason: The alcohol association concerns overall prostate cancer risk, with no aggressive disease definition.
